blurb: The club hosts kart racing events for drivers of all skill levels on a 750 meter track. It focuses on safety, fun, and education. Members typically own their own karts and safety gear, but rental karts are available through a partner for beginners and special classes.
extraNote: Spectating is free · Club does not own or manage rental karts; rentals and private events handled by partner Nonstop Racing · Track located on the grounds of the Lombardy Agricultural Society
